evidence.quote: Compared to prior work on multi-modal detection, we explicitly extract both geometric and semantic features from the 2D images.
The 2D vote reduces the search space of the 3D object center to a ray while the color texture in image provides a strong semantic prior.

solution.summary: In this work, we build on top of VOTE N ET and propose a 3D detection architecture called I M VOTE N ET specialized for RGB-D scenes. We leverage camera parameters to lift these features to 3D.

evidence.quote: In this work, we build on top of VOTE N ET and propose a 3D detection architecture called I M VOTE N ET specialized for RGB-D scenes.
We leverage camera parameters to lift these features to 3D.
In our work, we build upon the successful VOTE N ET architecture [31] and design a joint 2D-3D voting scheme for 3D object detection named I M VOTE N ET.

experiments.summary: Our model achieves the state-of-theart results while showing a significant improvement (+5.7 mAP) over the 3D geometry only VOTE N ET, validating the usefulness of image votes and 2D features. The designed deep network I M VOTE N ET achieves state-of-the-art 3D object detection

evidence.quote: Our model achieves the state-of-theart results while showing a significant improvement (+5.7 mAP) over the 3D geometry only VOTE N ET, validating the usefulness of image votes and 2D features.
The designed deep network I M VOTE N ET achieves state-of-the-art 3D object detection performance on SUN RGB-D.

limitations.summary: However, point cloud data have inherent limitations.
items: However, point cloud data have inherent limitations.
They are sparse, lack color information and often suffer from sensor noise.
Yet how to effectively use image information to assist point cloud based detection is still an open question.
However, how to make effective use of 2D images in a 3D detection pipeline is still an open problem.
